_RCMP_ serious crime investigators from Kamloops and Prince George will investigate the death of a Williams Lake man in police custody.
_Paul_ _Alphonse_, 67, died Tuesday in hospital Tuesday. He had been arrested in Williams Lake seven days previous for being drunk in a public place.

After his arrest, _Alphonse_ was taken to the Williams Lake _RCMP_ detachment. More than four hours later, he complained of chest pains and was taken to the hospital. He remained in hospital until his death.

Even though _Alphonse_ died in hospital, police are treating the matter as an in-custody death, as _Alphonse_ was under lawful arrest at the time. An autopsy will be performed to determine the cause of death.
The investigating team will also look at reports that _Alphonse_ was the victim of excessive force during the course of the initial arrest.

The patrol officer who made the arrest remains on active duty pending the result of the investigation. Senior _RCMP_ officers from the Williams Lake detachment are working with officials from the Williams lake Indian Band, police spokesman said.
The arresting officer's name was not released.
It's _RCMP_ policy to turn investigations like this over to _RCMP_ members from outside the detachment, the spokesman said.
